acceptance_criteria: The use-codex skill and durable Beads memory explicitly route heavy/many stock documents to Luna high/xhigh; relevant accumulated files pass structural checks; only intended paths are staged; a narrow checkpoint commit is created; the goal remains not activated.
notes: Persisted the reinforced policy in Beads and the repository-wide use-codex skill: heavy or numerous stock-related documents are split into bounded packages and delegated to separate Luna CLI agents at high by default or xhigh for dense, ambiguous, cross-document, or high-stakes work. Fresh checks passed for TOML/config load, Codex harness discovery, pinned blueprint hashes, goal inventory and inactive state, embedded validator syntax, Markdown links, scope behavior assertions, repository-relative paths, Beads remote, and absence of post-activation artifacts.

The contract must define source authority, autonomous spec-plan-execute-review loops, model routing, blueprint ledger semantics, human-review parking, and a verifiable stopping condition.
acceptance_criteria: A draft goal document exists under docs/goals, is grounded in the two user-designated blueprint authorities, has been brainstormed and reviewed by GPT-5.6 Sol xhigh through Codex CLI, names unresolved conflicts and assumptions, and is not activated until the user approves it.
notes: Drafted docs/goals/equity-os-blueprint-completion.md from the two pinned blueprint authorities. Codex CLI Sol xhigh brainstormed/authored and completed five independent review rounds. Round 5 returned four scope-normalization findings; a capped post-review Sol xhigh authoring pass applied those exact recommendations without a sixth review. Root deterministic verification passed: draft/inactive boundary, pinned hashes, 25 specs, 60 unique register IDs, 45 Open/15 Deferred, six links, three embedded Python blocks parse/compile, Luna high/xhigh never-medium routing, repaired scope checks, no machine-local paths, and no post-activation artifacts. The user must review and explicitly approve before goal activation. No goal tool, implementation epic, specs, roadmap, product code, commit, or push was created.
close_reason: Reviewable pre-activation goal contract drafted and deterministically verified; awaiting separate user approval before activation.
